controlCommands.name: create
controlCommands.summary: Use one shell command: `/create`. By default it creates the business, schedules the CEO, and starts one bootstrap turn.

examples.label: Basic
examples.command: /create latexflow "Build a SaaS that helps researchers turn LaTeX notes into polished PDF handouts and study packs."

examples.label: Test mode with wakeups
examples.command: /create --test --schedule "every 6h" latexflow "Build this business end to end in test mode."

examples.label: Record only
examples.command: /create --no-auto latexflow "Overleaf competitor for LaTeX power users"

flags.name: --test
flags.description: allow product/website publish; suppress outreach, spend, and money movement

flags.name: --no-auto
flags.description: create or update only; do not run or auto-schedule the CEO

flags.name: --auto
flags.description: accepted for compatibility; auto-start is already the default

flags.name: --schedule
flags.description: set the CEO wake cadence, for example "every 6h"

controlCommands.name: budget
controlCommands.description: Show or set business budget cap

controlCommands.name: test
controlCommands.summary: Test mode is per business: product/website work can publish, outreach and spend stay suppressed.

examples.label: Create, start the CEO, and schedule wakeups in test mode
Return the current business to live mode

controlCommands.name: wake
controlCommands.description: Wake Hermes CEO for the current business

controlCommands.name: run
controlCommands.description: Run a CEO instruction for the current business

controlCommands.name: delete
controlCommands.description: Delete the current business after preview
controlCommands.summary: Dry-run by default; with `--confirm` deletes the business database rows, `.takyon/businesses/<business>`, Takyon CEO cron jobs, and the business subdomain on fourmanifold.com via Vercel.

flags.name: --confirm
flags.description: permanently delete after showing the same candidates in preview

flags.name: --no-files
flags.description: leave the business filesystem tree in place

flags.name: --no-cron
flags.description: leave matching Takyon cron jobs in place

flags.name: --domain
flags.description: also remove an explicit business-owned subdomain under the base domain

controlCommands.name: secret
controlCommands.description: List redacted secret keys or set one

controlCommands.name: app-server
controlCommands.description: Run the local product app API server

controlCommands.name: gc
controlCommands.description: Garbage collect stale ephemeral Takyon state
